description: Commit — behavioral commitment trust scores for npm, PyPI, Cargo, and Go packages. Catches single-publisher concentration risk the axios (March 30 2026) and LiteLLM (March 27 2026) supply chain attacks exploited.

audit_api.description: Score one or more packages. Body: {"packages":["axios","zod"]}. Returns score (0-100), maintainers, weeklyDownloads, ageYears, trend, riskFlags, scorecardScore, scoreBreakdown per package.
audit_api.auth: none for ≤200 req/day; Bearer key for higher tiers

trust_page_api.description: Returns HTML page with the GitHub repository's commitment trust score and signal breakdown. For programmatic JSON, use audit_api above with the package name.

mcp.description: MCP server for querying Commit trust signals from agent context. 9 tools including audit_dependencies, lookup_npm_package, lookup_pypi_package, lookup_cargo_crate, lookup_go_module, lookup_github_repo, lookup_business, lookup_business_by_org, query_commitment.
